mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_audit_log (user_id, operation, timestamp, details) VALUES (#{userId}, #{operation}, NOW(), #{details})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, operation, timestamp, details FROM chat_audit_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY timestamp DESC
SELECT id, user_id, operation, timestamp, details FROM chat_audit_log WHERE operation = #{operation} ORDER BY timestamp DESC
SELECT id, user_id, operation, timestamp, details FROM chat_audit_log WHERE timestamp BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY timestamp DESC
SELECT id, user_id, operation, timestamp, details FROM chat_audit_log ORDER BY timestamp DESC
SELECT id, user_id, operation, timestamp, details FROM chat_audit_log ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
